statement: Community device protocol models GET feature 0x09 as pairing/MAC identity (20 bytes total), populated from per-device identity, used by Linux/SDL for identification. It is not a generic player-index field and must not contain a fixed public real MAC.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: VIIPER docs 269-280; HHD GET_REPORT 195-213; Linux 1183-1203; SDL 418-425. Source-supported shape, no real pairing keys or physical MAC bytes stored.
